items.source: Return the object that was bound or throw a NoSuchElementException if no value was bound.
items.translation: 返回已绑定的对象，或者如果未绑定任何值则抛出 NoSuchElementException。

items.source: Returns true if a result was bound.
items.translation: 如果已绑定结果，则返回true。

items.source: Return the object that was bound, or other if no value has been bound.
items.translation: 返回已绑定的对象，或者如果未绑定任何值则返回 `other`。

items.source: Return the object that was bound, or the result of invoking other if no value has been bound.
items.translation: 返回已绑定的对象，或者如果未绑定任何值，则返回调用 `other` 的结果。

items.source:
Invoke the specified consumer with the bound value, or do nothing if no value has
been bound.
items.translation: 调用已绑定指定消费者的值，或者如果未绑定任何值则不执行任何操作。

items.source:
Apply the provided mapping function to the bound value, or return an updated
unbound result if no value has been bound.
items.translation: 对绑定的值应用提供的映射函数，或者如果未绑定任何值，则返回更新后的未绑定结果。

items.source:
Return the object that was bound, or throw an exception to be created by the
provided supplier if no value has been bound.
items.translation: 返回已绑定的对象，或者如果未绑定任何值，则抛出由提供的 Supplier 创建的异常。

items.source: A container object to return the result of a Binder bind operation. May contain either a successfully bound object or an empty result.
items.translation: 一个容器对象，用于返回 `Binder` 绑定操作的结果。可能包含已成功绑定的对象或空结果。

items.source: other - a Supplier of the value to be returned if there is no bound value
items.translation: other - 如果没有绑定值，则返回该 Supplier 提供的值

items.source: T - the result type
items.translation: T - 结果类型

items.source: NoSuchElementException - if no value was bound
items.translation: NoSuchElementException - 如果未绑定任何值

items.source: U - the type of the result of the mapping function
items.translation: U - 映射函数结果类型

items.source: an BindResult describing the result of applying a mapping function to the value of this BindResult.
items.translation: 一个描述将映射函数应用于此BindResult的值的结果的BindResult。

items.source: other - the value to be returned if there is no bound value (may be null)
items.translation: other - 如果没有绑定值，则返回该值（可能为 null）

items.source: X - the type of the exception to be thrown
items.translation: X - 要抛出的异常的类型

items.source: the bound value (never null)
items.translation: 绑定值（永远不为null）

items.source: consumer - block to execute if a value has been bound
items.translation: consumer - 如果已绑定值，则执行此块。

items.source: mapper - a mapping function to apply to the bound value. The mapper will not be invoked if no value has been bound.
items.translation: mapper - 一个应用于绑定值的映射函数。如果没有绑定值，则不会调用该映射器。

items.source: the value, if bound, otherwise other
items.translation: 如果已绑定，则为该值；否则为other。

items.source: the value, if bound, otherwise the supplied other
items.translation: 如果已绑定则返回该值，否则返回提供的other。

items.source: X - if there is no value present
items.translation: X - 如果不存在值

items.source: if a result was bound
items.translation: 如果已绑定结果

items.source: the present value
items.translation: 现值

items.source: equals in class Object
items.translation: `equals` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: hashCode in class Object
items.translation: `hashCode` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: exceptionSupplier - the supplier which will return the exception to be thrown
items.translation: exceptionSupplier - 用于返回要抛出的异常的供应器

items.source: Phillip Webb, Madhura Bhave
items.translation: Phillip Webb，Madhura Bhave
